title: The Quiet Glasshouse
author: Lior Eastwick
blurb: Coral Ishikawa, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
